conviction_note: The evidence is balanced. Third-party usage data (Evercore, Oct 19) and management's own monthly DAU trajectory point to an improving Tinder print, but both were largely public and the stock ran +21% on them. A stronger dollar since the July 28 guide rates and Hinge deceleration are small negatives for the Q4 guide. MTCH sold off its last EBITDA beat (-7.5% in Aug 2026). So p_up sits at 52 on a 9.0% move scale. The +0.5 findings sum and the +0.36 scaled number agree in sign and size.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue: company guide $885-895M, adjusted EBITDA $330-335M (Q2 2026 shareholder letter, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000891103/000089110326000128/mtch8-k20260804ex992.htm). Consensus revenue $891.6M (-2.5% y/y) and EPS $1.05, whisper $1.08 (Earnings Whispers preview 2026-10-26, https://finviz.com/news/407957/match-groups-rally-puts-tinders-promised-usage-turn-on-trial-this-quarter). A second source agrees: StockStory/Yahoo 2026-11-01 says consensus is -2.4% y/y, about $892M (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/earnings-watch-match-group-mtch-072300117.html). Consensus sits just above the guide midpoint and has drifted down from about $895M. The non-revenue bar is the line the stock has traded on: Tinder DAU turning positive y/y (management said 'any day now'; July was -2.5%, August reportedly near flat) and the Tinder payer decline (-5% in Q2) narrowing, with Tinder payer growth targeted only for late 2027.
positioning_check: Short interest is about 11.4M shares with about 3.0 days to cover at the 2026-09-30 FINRA settlement (massive.com via search snippet, https://massive.com/quote/mtch). It was 11.0M shares and 4.8 days on 2026-08-20 (https://equibles.com/stocks/mtch/shortinterest). That is roughly 5% of shares and not crowded. Borrow fee is about 0.3% (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/mtch/). Skew is -0.34 vol points, balanced, and the baseline's priced lean is 'balanced'. Put/call open interest is 0.33, so the front expiry is call-heavy. The event-implied move is 9.13% against a 7.49% median past reaction. The stock rose about 21% after the Q2 print to a post-earnings high of $46.67 (EW, 10-26). It then fell 9.2% in the week to Oct 28 ($42.06, -3.7% that day) with no news cause found, and is at $41.88 at seal (5-day run-up -7.37%, 20-day +3.84%).

findings.finding: On 2026-10-19 Evercore ISI (Mark Mahaney) upgraded MTCH from In Line to Outperform and raised the target from $39 to $53, citing app-usage data and its own surveys. These suggest Tinder's recovery is accelerating and could beat management's MAU and payer expectations through 2027. Against that, the Q2 bar is Tinder MAU -7% y/y and payers -5%. Consensus revenue ($891.6M) sits only at the guide midpoint, so street numbers have not moved up with the usage data.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: When Tinder user trends improved, the stock rose: Q3 2025 (2025-11-04) +5.2% and Q4 2025 (2026-02-03) +5.9%. On Q2 2026 (2026-08-04), DAU improved to -4% but payers fell 5.7% and revenue slightly missed ($853.1M vs $857.8M), and the stock fell 7.49%. Usage gains without payer gains have not been paid for.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock rose about 5% on the upgrade day (Frankfurt +4.9%) and reached $46.67. It has since given back about 9% in a week without a stated cause, which removes much of that move. Consensus revenue and EPS did not rise after the note (revenue drifted down from about $895M). If the usage read were fully priced, the bar would sit at the top of the guide.
findings.independence: Management's own monthly DAU series points the same way (Q2 letter: July DAU -2.5%, fifth straight monthly improvement, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000891103/000089110326000128/mtch8-k20260804ex992.htm). The German write-up of the same upgrade is https://goldesel.de/aktien/news/match-aktie-evercore-hebt-rating-auf-outperform-und-kursziel-auf-53-dollar. This is a third-party proxy relayed by a broker; the underlying Sensor Tower numbers were not reachable.

findings.finding: Management's own Tinder DAU path is Q2 -4% y/y, July -2.5% (fifth straight monthly improvement) and, per the Earnings Whispers preview, August close to flat, with management expecting a positive y/y 'any day now'. On that path Q3 DAU averages about -1% to flat, and a positive September or October month is likely to be disclosed. This would be the first positive y/y DAU in more than three years. The bar is that improvement continues; a first positive month is the upside case.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 DAU at -4% was 'the best in 10 quarters' and the stock still fell 7.49% on payers and revenue. DAU alone has not carried a print.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: management told the market to expect it, and every preview names DAU turning positive as the test. What is not priced is the size of the turn and whether MAU (-7% in Q2) follows. A clear positive DAU month with MAU narrowing to about -4% would beat the preview framing; DAU near flat with MAU at -6% would read as a stall.
findings.independence: The August 'close to flat' comes from the Earnings Whispers preview of 2026-10-26 (https://finviz.com/news/407957/match-groups-rally-puts-tinders-promised-usage-turn-on-trial-this-quarter), which is AI-assisted and cites management. The July figure and the 'any day now' remark share the Q2 document with the guidance finding below.

findings.finding: In the Q2 letter, full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA was guided at or above the high end of the February range ($1.280-1.325B), with margin above 37.5%. FCF was guided to the high end ($1.085-1.135B), SBC lowered to $230-240M, and the Tinder product-test drag cut from $60M to $30-40M. Alternative-payment savings run at about $130M for the year. This sets up a second margin and FCF raise at Q3, while the revenue guide holds near the midpoint as reported.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In Q2 2026, adjusted EBITDA rose 14% with a 39% margin and the full-year EBITDA was effectively raised, yet the stock fell 7.49% on the revenue and payer lines. Margin beats have not been paid for on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced, because the company already guided to the high end. The unpriced part is a raise above the high end, given a $10M Q3 Tinder test drag inside a $30-40M full-year envelope and the alternative-payment savings. If priced, consensus EPS would sit above $1.05; the whisper at $1.08 says part of it is.
findings.independence: Same document as the DAU finding, but a different line (margin and FCF versus usage). The EW preview says FCF is tracking toward the high end and alternative-payment savings are about $130M (https://finviz.com/news/407957/match-groups-rally-puts-tinders-promised-usage-turn-on-trial-this-quarter).

findings.finding: The dollar strengthened after the July 28 rates on which the Q3 and full-year guides rest. EUR/USD went from about 1.17 in August to below 1.1325 on 2026-09-29 and about 1.116 in early October, and the dollar rose about 2.5% against the euro in September alone. The Q3 average was roughly flat (DXY +0.2% over the quarter), so Q3 revenue is close to FX-neutral against the guide. The Q4 guide will be struck at a stronger dollar, which could cost about 0.5 to 1 point of reported Q4 revenue against a consensus built on the July rates. The yen strengthened (USD/JPY -3.2% in Q3), a partial offset for Match's Japan business.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: the full-year FX view was cut by half a point to a half-point tailwind, and the -7.49% reaction centred on revenue and payers. FX was not called out as the driver. No clean history of an FX-only guide reaction was found.
findings.why_not_priced: Analysts often roll FX into Q4 numbers only after the company restates its guide rates. Q4 consensus is not available here, so whether it was cut is unverified. If it had been, the Q4 revenue estimate would sit about $5-8M lower than the implied full-year guide midpoint minus the first three quarters.
findings.independence: This is a macro-to-company proxy that the company has not confirmed. FX quarter data is from https://www.bbva.es/en/empresas/productos/negocio-internacional/noticias-comex/actualidad-mercado-fx-oct26.html and the NAGA outlook, https://naga.com/en/news-and-analysis/articles/forex-market-outlook. The search-result sources disagree on exact levels.

findings.finding: Hinge, about a quarter of revenue and the growth engine, is decelerating. Direct revenue grew 22% in Q2 against 28% in Q1, global MAU rose 13% but was flat in core markets, and the company planned to test an additional, reportedly lower-priced, subscription tier in Q3 that could dilute revenue per payer. Hinge guidance (low-to-mid 20s growth for the year) was only held, not raised. A Q3 at or below about 20% would cut against the $1B-in-2027 target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Hinge strength did not offset Tinder payer declines in Q2 2026 (-7.49%). No print found where a Hinge miss alone drove the reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: The previews centre on Tinder; the EW preview mentions the tier test only in passing. If priced, Hinge would be framed as a risk to the 2027 target. Net of the rest of the company: Tinder is about 55% of revenue, so a 2-point Hinge shortfall is about $4-5M of group revenue, which a better Tinder line can offset.
findings.independence: The EW preview independently flags the lower-priced tier weighing on Hinge revenue per payer (https://finviz.com/news/407957/match-groups-rally-puts-tinders-promised-usage-turn-on-trial-this-quarter).

findings.finding: Positioning into the print: the stock rose about 21% from the post-Q2 low to $46.67 while the S&P fell about 2%, and EW put sentiment at 'moderately bullish'. Front-expiry put/call open interest is 0.33 (call-heavy). The stock then fell 9.2% in the week to Oct 28 with no news cause found, and seals at $41.88. Short interest of about 11.4M shares (about 3.0 days) is not crowded, so a squeeze is not a strong mechanism.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: after a rally into the print (the stock was in the high $30s in late July), the reaction was -7.49%.
findings.why_not_priced: Ambiguous. The late-October drop may have already flushed the call-heavy longs, in which case this is near 0. If the call open interest is still in place, a merely in-line print unwinds it.
findings.independence: The week's drop is from the gurufocus headline via search (https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9149085/match-group-inc-mtch-stock-down-37-but-still-overvalued-gf-score-86100; fetch was 403). Put/call open interest is from the sealed baseline.

outside_window.finding: Apple's contempt appeal in Epic v. Apple (the US link-out commission) is before the Supreme Court in the term starting October 2026, with a ruling expected in 2027. A ruling permitting a commission would erode Match's roughly $130M of alternative-payment savings.
Peers Bumble and Grindr report Q3 after the close on 2026-11-05, after the window; no peer dating read-through lands before MTCH prints.

baseline_tension: The evidence is mildly positive and agrees with a balanced skew. It sits uneasily with the 21% post-Q2 rally, now partly unwound by the -7.4% five-day drop, which suggests the usage optimism is no longer fully in the price but leaves the reaction to payers and the Q4 guide.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): MTCH fell 7.49% on its last margin beat and DAU improvement, so the Evercore usage finding went from +1.0 to +0.8 and the EBITDA/FCF raise finding from +0.4 to +0.3.
Lesson 6 (a finding inside the guide): the DAU trajectory is what management already said ('any day now'), so it went from +0.5 to +0.3.
Lesson 5 (a proxy is sized small, not dropped): the FX finding stays filed at -0.3 with independence marked as a proxy.
Lesson 7 (look up short interest before a negative): short interest is not crowded (about 3 days), so the positioning negative is unchanged at -0.3.
Lesson 9 (size a segment net of the rest): the Hinge finding already nets it against Tinder at about 55% of revenue; unchanged at -0.3.
abs_move_pct and p_up are unchanged (9.0, 52); expected_move_pct stays at 0.36.
